{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}')
print('QA order IDs:', qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Remove QA orders
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Remove refunded orders
sales_final = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the final dataset
print(f'Final dataset shape: {sales_final.shape}')

# Now, look at customer_age
print('\nUnique values in customer_age:\n', sales_final['customer_age'].unique())
print('\nDistribution of customer_age:\n', sales_final['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())"}
